verses.text: “Job, do you know at what time/season of the year the female mountain goats give birth?
Do you know how many months pass from the time they become pregnant until their fawns are born?
When they give birth, they crouch down
The young fawns grow up in the open fields,
“Who allows the wild donkeys to go wherever they want [DOU]?
I am the one who put them in the desert,
They do not like the noise in the cities;
They go to the hills to find food;
:Will a wild ox agree to work for you?
And can you fasten it with a rope
Since it is very strong, can you trust it to work for you?
Can you rely on it to come back from the field,
“Think also about the ostriches. They joyfully flap their wings,
Ostriches lay their eggs on top of the ground and then walk away,
Ostriches do not worry that some wild animal may step on the eggs and crush them [DOU].
Ostriches act cruelly towards their chicks;
That is because I did not allow ostriches to be wise.
But, when they get up and begin to run,
And think about horses. Job, are you the one who caused horses to be strong?
Are you the one who enabled them to leap forward like locusts?
They paw the ground, rejoicing about being very strong,
It is as if they laugh at the thought of being afraid. They are not afraid of anything!
The quivers containing the riders’ arrows rattle against the horses’ sides,
The horses paw the ground fiercely/excitedly, wanting the battle to begin,
They neigh joyfully when they hear someone blowing the trumpet.
“And think about big birds. Are you the one who enabled hawks to spread their wings
Do eagles fly high up into the cliffs to make their nests
They live in holes in those cliffs.
As they watch carefully from there,
